reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: § 2.1 expressly disclaims any minimum quantity or purchase commitment and confirms Customer pays only for ordered Services, matching the MINCOMMIT preferred position.

Corroborating clauses are correctly read: § 7.1 bars unidentified minimum-use charges and § 12.3 confirms no minimum-volume commitment; no take-or-pay, shortfall penalty, or usage cap on Customer appears.
No redline or comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs and no deterministic checks failed.
Rationale correctly distinguishes the §§ 22.2–22.3 audit 'shortfall' references as true-ups for actual underpayment rather than a take-or-pay penalty.
